input.body: We are writing to request a review of a deduction of $28.40 on order DD-51152, dated 2026-11-07, which was taken with the reason "missing item" for Chicken Thukpa. The order ticket for DD-51152 lists Veg Momo (Steamed) and Samosa Chaat, and does not list Chicken Thukpa [DD-51152:ticket_omits_item]. The order was ready at 20:26 and was picked up by the courier at 20:29, three minutes later [DD-51152:pickup_handoff]. We understand the ticket shows what was ordered and prepared, and we are not able to show the contents of the bag from this evidence. Because the claimed item does not appear on the order ticket, we respectfully ask that the deduction be reviewed and reversed. Thank you for your time and consideration.
